title: Velocity Flyer Credit Card: 50k Velocity Pts + 50 Status Credits ($1.5k/month spend first 2 months), $169 AF @ Virgin Money
body:
Deal: Velocity Flyer Credit Card: 50k Velocity Pts + 50 Status Credits ($1.5k/month spend first 2 months), $169 AF @ Virgin Money

[soan papdi] Shouldn’t you be telling us? FWIW it used to be $129 flight credit, which is much better.
[mister_snrub] It's in the terms and conditions at the bottom of the page.
The Virgin Australia Gift Voucher is available to Primary Cardholders only and provides one Virgin Australia Gift Voucher to the value of $129 (AUD) each year, in the form of a $129 travel credit in a Virgin Australia Travel Bank. You will become eligible for your $129 Virgin Australia Gift Voucher after card approval in your first year and after your card anniversary thereafter provided you have made a retail purchase as the Primary Cardholder in the 2 months prior to requesting your voucher…
[soan papdi] Not sure these days but approx 2 years back this card was awesome in that govt charges also counted toward the minimum spend (not for earning points, which is fine). Many cards don't allow govt charges for minimum spend.
[tobi3421] Does anyone know if minimum spend is first 30 days or when the first statement comes out?
From other threads the first statement comes out within 2-3 weeks of activating the card
[soan papdi] yeah they count the first month from issue date but it takes a week (or whatever it takes) for the card to arrive.
[mister_snrub] Also in the terms and conditions:
25,000 Bonus Velocity Points will be awarded for each month $1,500 or more is spent on eligible purchases for the first 60 days from approval. The first month begins on the date your account is approved. Please allow up to 1 week for your card to be mailed to you, leaving you about 3 weeks to meet the spend hurdle for the first month. The second month will commence one month from the date your account is approved.
[whyisave] Your approval date is the start date of the 1st month, but you may receive the physical card, about 08 - 12 days after your approval date.
[rith] I can confirm that the spend is from 30 days of approval. The first statement does indeed come sooner than a month, so the first set of bonus points won't come until the second statement. And then the next set from the third statement.
[tobi3421] Thanks guys, and to the replies above too
[TsunamiJ] What are the chances to appeal with Virgin Money as the first month was too short. I underspent by $250.
[pvl] I lost my points around $500 in 2024 because i didn't use it for a while. Be aware.
[soan papdi] Virgin Australia Velocity Frequent Flyer points expire after 24 consecutive months of account inactivity.
It's not specific to this card.
[mister_snrub] Nope. This has always been a great card for churners.
The terms and conditions for the signup bonus state:
Offer is not available to existing Virgin Money Credit Card holders (including upgrades).
So as long as you don't currently hold another Virgin Money credit card, you are eligible.
[AriesB] I thought Virgin Money rejected most churners like last year?
[ricky56789] They rejected me when others didn't, I churn a little bit
[nightelves] @ricky56789: Yeah you have to churn a lot for them not to reject you.
[dealsgrabber] @ricky56789: Try the High Flyer card if you are ok with the higher spend requirement. Even though they reject you for this, they approve the High Flyer card on the other hand.
Happens me to me and a few others before.
[abhiz] Can’t see in the T&C. Keen to know this bit too?

[Logortz] Hodl until opt in for bonus points for new card application?
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/963035
[ozzieozzieozzie] Bonus Velocity points are 25k per month, providing you spend $1500 per month for two consecutive months from card approval date. So 25k + 25k. Miss the spend criteria in any of the first two months, you miss out on 25k points.
[meowmeowmeow] Damn I got declined. They must be cracking down on churners. How annoying.
